description_zh: Lindorm包年包月类型实例续费
kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb renew-lindorm-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ld-bp1z3506imz2f0000 --pricing-cycle Month --duration 1 --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewLindormInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426069.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle for the instance renewal. Valid values:

Month: The instance is renewed by month.

Year: The instance is renewed by year
parameters.help_zh:
实例购买的付费周期，取值：

Month：单位为月。
Year：单位为年
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If you set PricingCycle to Month, the valid values for this parameter are 1 to 9.

If you set PricingCycle to Year, the valid values for this parameter are 1 to 3
parameters.help_zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

PricingCycle为Month，表示按月付费，取值范围为1~9。
PricingCycle为Year，表示按年付费，取值范围为1~3
parameters.name: duration

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the order. You can find the order ID in the Order Management section of Expenses and Costs
OrderId.description_zh: 订单ID。您可以在阿里云费用与成本的订单管理中获取
